new_today_news.headline: Webster completes $16 million wastewater plant upgrade
new_today_news.summary: The village of Webster, New York completed a $16 million upgrade to its wastewater treatment plant, replacing aging equipment and improving the system serving Monroe County residents and businesses. The work is intended to improve treatment reliability and protect water quality in Lake Ontario's Rochester Embayment.

new_today_news.headline: Driving the Circular Economy: HydroCycle Embarks on New Liquid Waste Recycling Venture
new_today_news.summary: Waste360 reports on HydroCycle's new liquid waste recycling initiative as part of circular economy efforts in the waste industry.

recent_news.headline: NYC Restaurants Shut Off Air Conditioning, Close on Sundays as Costs Surge
recent_news.summary: New York City restaurants are implementing extreme cost-cutting measures including shutting off air conditioning and closing on Sundays as gas and electric bills spike to record levels amid mounting inflation.

recent_news.headline: Public Health Warning Issued Related To Recent Sewage Discharge
recent_news.summary: Boston issued public health warnings for combined sewer overflows (CSOs) on October 11-12, 2026, affecting Fort Point Channel and Inner Harbor areas. State regulations require notification when discharge-related risks persist beyond two hours.

recent_news.headline: Darling Ingredients (NYSE:DAR) Reports Quarterly Growth and Business Developments
recent_news.summary: Darling Ingredients operates in sustainable ingredients and renewable fuels, transforming animal by-products, food waste and used cooking oil into commercial materials. Through Diamond Green Diesel, the company converts waste fats and oils into renewable diesel and lower-carbon fuel products.

recent_news.headline: Why Is Darling Ingredients (NYSE:DAR) Drawing Russell 1000 Attention?
recent_news.summary: Darling Ingredients collects and processes animal by-products, food waste and used cooking oil into ingredients and renewable fuels through Diamond Green Diesel's waste fats and oils conversion operations.

recent_news.headline: Waste Hauler Insurance: Liability Coverage, Requirements, and Risk Management
recent_news.summary: Guide covering waste hauler insurance coverage types, cost factors, and operational requirements. Notes that pricing is influenced by waste types, collection methods, vehicle values, operating territory, and driver records.

backfill_news.headline: Commission directs staff to revisit transfer-station rates as landfill tipping fees rise
backfill_news.summary: Marion County commissioners directed staff to rework tire and construction debris fee schedules in light of expected tipping-fee increases to $54/ton. The presentation focused on transfer-station operations and the impact of projected landfill tipping-fee increases.

backfill_news.headline: Renewable Water Resources Sewer Use Regulation - FOG Enforcement Response Guide Amendment
backfill_news.summary: ReWa amended its Sewer Use Regulation effective October 1, 2026, including updates to FOG Enforcement Response Guide and pretreatment program definitions and requirements.

backfill_news.headline: National Restaurant Association State of the Industry Report shows profitability pressures
backfill_news.summary: A third of restaurant operators reported being unprofitable in the first half of 2026, with weak traffic particularly among low-income consumers constraining sales despite technology investments not delivering expected cost relief.
